entry.title: Six publishers agree to feed 20 million research papers to AI agents, in a pay-per-use deal
entry.summary:
Kamfanonin buga littattafan ilimi shida, da suka haɗa da Sage, Ƙungiyar BMJ da Cibiyar Physics (Institute of Physics), sun amince da bai wa kamfani mai farawa na ƙasar Sweden, Redpine, damar ciyar da fiye da takardu miliyan 20 da masana suka tantance ga tsarin AI a cikin lokaci na ainihi, kamar yadda jaridar Times Higher Education ta ruwaito a ranar 6 ga Oktoba, 2026. Yarjejeniyar, wadda ake biyan kuɗi bisa yawan amfani, tana biyan kamfanonin buga littattafai da marubuta duk sa'ad da tsarin AI ya yi amfani da aikinsu, kuma ta shafi mujallu na likitanci, ilimin rayuwa da kimiyyar lissafi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai ɗauke da nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, yarjejeniyar ta zama gwaji na farko na yadda buga littattafan ilimi zai iya tabbatar da cewa AI na dogara da bincike mai tabbaci maimakon zato, tare da kuma warware tambayar wanda zai samu kuɗi idan na'ura, ba mai karatu ba, ce take yin ambato.

Times Higher Education · Established press (Times Higher Education)

entry.title: Mystery-shopper study finds university enquiry replies 'costing enrolments', as ChatGPT outperforms
entry.summary:
Wani bincike na mai sayayya asiri da ya shafi jami'o'i 30 na Birtaniya da 30 na Ostareliya, wanda kamfanin ba da shawara Edified da kamfanin ɗaukar ma'aikata UniQuest suka gudanar, kuma jaridar Times Higher Education ta ruwaito a ranar 1 ga Oktoba, 2026, ya nuna cewa kashi 37 cikin ɗari kaɗai na tambayoyin ɗalibai masu neman shiga jami'a, wajen 700, ne suka samu amsa da ta ƙarfafa su su ci gaba da tuntuɓa. Kashi 15 cikin ɗari na tambayoyin ba su samu amsa ko ɗaya ba, kuma an ƙididdige amsoshin ChatGPT a matsayin masu sauri, cikakku, kuma masu ƙarfin yarda fiye da na jami'o'in da kansu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan nazarin bayanai da bayanai don tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, binciken ya zama tunatarwa mai ƙarfi cewa cibiyoyin da suke tattara bayanan masu neman shiga dole su ma su yi aiki da waɗannan bayanai, domin kusan ɗalibai biyu cikin uku a cikin wannan tsokaci sun kasance ba su gamsu ba da amsar da ɗan'adam ya bayar, wanda AI mai kyau tambaya zai iya yin shi da kyau fiye da haka.

Times Higher Education · Established press (Times Higher Education), citing a study by Edified and UniQuest

entry.title: How computer-science students actually use large language models varies sharply by task, study finds
entry.summary:
Wata takarda ta bincike da aka buga a arXiv a ranar 1 ga Oktoba, 2026 ta bincika yadda ɗalibai 211 na digiri na farko suka yi amfani da manyan ƙirar harshe a cikin sassa bakwai na kwas na warware matsalolin kimiyyar kwamfuta. Ɗalibai sun fi amfani da waɗannan kayan aiki wajen algoriti da raya shafukan yanar gizo, kuma sun fi ƙarancin amfani da su a injiniyan software, inda galibi suke ɗauka su a matsayin mataimaka da za a bincika maimakon hukuma da za a amince da ita, suna tabbatar da sakamakon ta hanyar gwaji a cikin ayyuka masu tsari da ta hanyar bincike a yanar gizo a cikin ayyukan buɗaɗɗu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, binciken da ya nuna cewa al'adar tabbatarwa tana canzawa bisa irin aikin, ba ɗalibin kaɗai ba, shi ne alama bayyananna ta yadda gaskiyar ilimi da tsarin tantancewa ya kamata su daidaita bisa kowane aiki.

arXiv · Working paper (arXiv preprint)

entry.title: Cross-border virtual teamwork lifts intercultural readiness in data-analytics and machine-learning courses, study finds
entry.summary:
Wata takarda ta bincike da aka buga a arXiv a ranar 1 ga Oktoba, 2026 daga Sehrish Basir Nizamani da abokan aikinta, ta bayyana shirin musaya ta yanar gizo mai tsari, wanda ya haɗa ɗaliban digiri na farko a kimiyyar kwamfuta daga Amurka da Pakistan don aiwatar da aikin nazarin bayanai da koyon na'ura cikin matakai shida da ba a lokaci guda ba. Ɗalibai sun ba da rahoton kyakkyawan gogewa a koyaushe, kuma masu binciken sun gano cewa sadarwa tsakanin al'adu daban daban, fiye da ƙwarewar fasaha, ita ce ta fi tasiri a yadda suka ji shirye don aiki na duniya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Dangane da ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin bayanai a fannin STEM da horar da malamai, binciken yana bayar da misali da aka gwada na aikin haɗin gwiwa mai tsallake ƙasashe wanda ba a lokaci guda ba, wanda ɗaliban kimiyyar kwamfuta na Kudancin Duniya suke bukata domin gina ƙwarewar fasaha tare da ƙwarewar al'adu, ba tare da barin gida ba.

arXiv (accepted, IEEE Frontiers in Education 2026) · Working paper (arXiv preprint, accepted IEEE FIE 2026)

entry.title: Copenhagen university appoints an anthropologist, not a computer scientist, to lead its AI strategy
entry.summary:
University of Copenhagen ta naɗa masanin ilimin ɗan'adam Morten Axel Pedersen a matsayin mataimakin shugaban jami'a na farko kan AI, inda ta zaɓi masanin da ya fi fahimtar yadda mutane suke aiki a zahiri maimakon masanin kimiyyar kwamfuta domin jagorantar dabarun da suka kai kroner na Denmark miliyan 110, wadda ta haɗa da ofishin AI, ƙungiyar aiki, dakunan gwaje-gwaje da mataimaki na AI mai samar da abun ciki na musamman. Pedersen, wanda a baya ya shugabanci Cibiyar Nazarin Bayanan Zamantakewa ta jami'ar, na shirin bitar kowace kwas a jami'ar cikin shekara guda domin tantance yadda za a yi amfani da AI a kowanne. Ya kwatanta muƙaminsa na shekaru uku a matsayin tsarin ɗan lokaci da za a rushe sa'ad da kowace fanni ta samu nata ƙa'idoji.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, zaɓin Copenhagen yana nuna cewa yadda ɗalibai da ma'aikata suke amfani da AI a zahiri, ba abin da manufa ta ce kawai ba, shi ne mafarin da ya dace domin gyaran koyarwa da tantancewa; Wits AHEAD na ganin hakan a matsayin shaida cewa gudanar da AI a aji tambaya ta mutane ce kamar yadda take ta fasaha.

Times Higher Education (Seher Asaf) · Established press profile

entry.title: UK research network to redo grant review after AI triage rejected half of proposals
entry.summary:
CRANE, hanyar sadarwar bincike kan tsaron yanar gizo ta Biritaniya wacce take a University of Oxford kuma UKRI take goyon baya, ta amince ta sake yin nazarin kiran tallafinta bayan tsarin binciken farko na AI ya ƙi kusan rabin shawarwari 179 da ta samu kafin wani mai nazari ɗan'adam ya ganesu. Hanyar sadarwar ta ce ta yi amfani da tsarin kulle da amintattu maimakon kayan aikin AI na jama'a, kuma ba za a yi amfani da bayanan shawarwarin domin horar da kowane model ba; ta dakatar da tayin tallafin da aka riga aka bayar, yayin da kwamitinta ke sake nazarin kowace buƙatar da aka ƙi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai ɗauke da nauyi, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, lamarin yana nuna cewa daidaita ƙofar tallafin bincike ta atomatik ba tare da bayyanawa da hanyar ƙara ba na iya kawar da aiki na gaskiya kafin wani mutum ya karanta shi; Wits AHEAD tana nuni ga sake nazarin, ba kuskuren kawai ba, a matsayin ma'aunin da ya kamata kowace cibiya mai amfani da AI wajen nazarin babban haɗari ta bi.

Times Higher Education (Frances Jones) · Established press investigation

entry.title: Tshwane University of Technology dialogue presses South Africa to move from AI strategy to implementation
entry.summary:
Cibiyar Nazarin Makomar Aiki ta Tshwane University of Technology ta shirya Tattaunawar Makomar Aiki ta biyar a birnin Pretoria, tana haɗa gwamnati, masana da masu harkar kasuwanci a karkashin jigon ci gaba da juriya a makomar Afirka ta hanyar ƙirƙira mai ƙarfin AI. Babban darakta Tseliso Mohlomi ya ce Afirka ta Kudu dole ta koma daga dabara da muhawara zuwa aiwatarwa, yana ambaton tsaron yanar gizo, sarrafa girgije, ƙwarewar AI da injiniyan bayanai a matsayin bukatu na gaggawa na ƙwarewa. Taron ya sake maimaita shawarar da ba a aiwatar ba tun taron bara, na kafa Majalisar Ƙasa ta Aiwatar da AI domin daidaita gwamnati, jami'o'i da masu harkar kasuwanci.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 4, AI, ƙwarewar ɗalibai, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, nacin tattaunawar kan aiwatarwa maimakon ci gaba da manufofi yana da alaƙa kai tsaye da damuwar Wits AHEAD cewa takardun dabara kaɗai ba su samar da ayyukan yi ba; majalisar daidaitawa irin wadda aka gabatar ita ce tsarin da za a iya daidaita horon jami'o'i da ainihin bukatun ƙwarewa masu saurin canzawa.

iAfrica.com (Thebe Mabanga, Inside Education) · Established press report on a university-hosted policy dialogue

entry.title: Liberia advances a national education data system to inform real-time decisions
entry.summary:
Ma'aikatar Ilimi ta Laberiya ta kammala tattaunawa ta ƙasa da masu ruwa da tsaki kan sabon manufar Education Management Information System (EMIS), wanda Tarayyar Afirka take goyon baya ta hannun Pan-African Institute for Education and Development. Mataimakin Minista Thomas Momo Parker ya ce ana buƙatar bayanai amintattu kuma na daidai lokaci domin tsara shirye-shirye, kasafin kuɗi da yanke shawara, yayin da ma'aikatar take sake farawa Ƙidayar Shekara-shekara ta Makarantu tare da gabatar da littattafan rajista na shari'a a makarantu. Tattaunawar, da aka yi a Monrovia tare da Tarayyar Turai, UNESCO, Plan International Liberia da UNICEF, ta gano gibi a gudanar da bayanai, kayan aiki, ƙwarewar fasaha da kuɗaɗe.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 5, nazarin bayanai da bayanai domin tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, matakin Laberiya ya nuna cewa tushen bayanai na ƙasa, ba algorithm kaɗai ba, shi ne tushen da kowane tsarin Kudancin Duniya yake buƙata kafin a amince da kayan aikin hasashe ko dashboard; Wits AHEAD tana bin diddigin irin wannan tushe a matsayin sharaɗin nazarin bayanan da take bincika a sauran wurare.

African Newspage (Ministry of Education, Republic of Liberia) · National government announcement

entry.title: A college president on harnessing AI in education without cutting corners
entry.summary:
Shugaban Colby College, David Greene, ya shaida wa ABC News yadda wannan kwalejin liberal arts ta Amurka ke amfani da AI wajen koyarwa da koyo ta hanyar da ya bayyana a matsayin mai bin ɗa'a, ba tare da bin gajeriyar hanya ba. Wannan taƙaitaccen bayani ne kai tsaye kan jagorancin cibiya a fannin AI.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, ya nuna wani shugaban jami'a da ke ɗaukar AI a matsayin abin da za a tsara da gangan maimakon sa ido a kai kawai, matsayin da Wits AHEAD ke goyon baya a jami'o'in Afirka.

ABC News · ABC News (US national broadcaster)

entry.title: What should a university be in the age of AI? SABC News on the first Times Higher Education summit in Africa
entry.summary:
Gabanin taron Times Higher Education World Academic Summit, wanda University of Cape Town ta karɓi baƙuncinsa daga 29 ga Satumba zuwa 1 ga Oktoba, kuma shi ne na farko da aka gudanar a ƙasar Afirka, SABC News ta yi tambaya kan yadda ya kamata jami'a ta kasance yayin da AI ke sauya yadda mutane ke aiki, koyo da samar da ilimi. Mataimakin Shugaban Jami'ar UCT mai kula da Bincike da Hulɗar Ƙasa da Ƙasa, Farfesa Thokozani Majozi, ya tattauna taken taron, "Knowledge, justice and futures: Universities in the age of intelligence", da kuma rawar da jami'o'i ke takawa fiye da yaye ɗalibai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu da sauyinsu zuwa rayuwar aiki, tambayar taron kan haƙƙoƙin da ke wuyan jami'o'i ga waɗanda suka kammala karatu da al'umma yayin da AI ke sauya aiki ita ce tambayar ƙungiyar kanta, wadda yanzu ake yin ta a dandalin Afirka ta Kudu.

SABC News · SABC News (public broadcaster)

entry.title: African scholarship is building a decolonial agenda for AI in university classrooms, systematic review finds
entry.summary:
Wani bita na tsari a mujallar Trends in Higher Education ya yi nazari kan bincike 25 daga 2010 zuwa 2025 kan kawar da tasirin mulkin mallaka, AI da azuzuwan jami'a a manyan makarantun Afirka. Wallafe-wallafe sun ƙaru da sauri bayan 2020 a kan jigogi uku: rashin adalci a fannin ilimi da manhaja, mulkin mallaka ta hanyar algorithm da kwasar bayanai, da kuma sauye-sauyen koyarwa da AI mai samar da abun ciki ke buƙata. Bincike ya fi yawa a Afirka ta Kudu, tare da ayyukan da ke tasowa a matakin Afirka baki ɗaya kan AI a harsunan Afirka. Marubutan sun gano cewa wani daidaitaccen shirin bincike kan kawar da mulkin mallaka a AI yana ƙara kankama, amma har yanzu shaidun bincike na zahiri kaɗan ne.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki da manufofi, bitar ta bayyana tambayoyin ilimin wa da harsunan wa AI ke shigarwa cikin azuzuwan Afirka, kuma ta nuna yadda tushen shaidun bincike na zahiri ke da rauni har yanzu, giɓin da bincike a Wits School of Education zai iya taimakawa wajen cike shi.

Trends in Higher Education (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed systematic review

entry.title: AI emerges as a distinct part of the student academic experience in a survey of 2,403 Bolivian undergraduates
entry.summary:
Wani bincike kan ɗaliban digiri na farko 2,403 a wata jami'a mai zaman kanta a Bolivia, wanda aka buga a Education Sciences, ya tabbatar da ingancin takardar tambayoyi mai abubuwa 31 kan yanayin karatu a jami'a, kuma ya gano cewa amfani da AI wajen koyo, kamar yadda ɗalibai suka bayyana, ya zama wani rukuni na daban tare da shiga cikin karatu, tunani mai zurfi, ingancin koyarwa da jajircewa. Amfani da AI da ɗalibai suka bayyana yana da alaƙa mai kyau da shiga cikin karatu da kuma ƙwarewar sadarwa, ɗa'a da tunani mai zurfi; marubutan sun jaddada cewa ma'aunin yana auna ra'ayoyi ne, ba sakamakon koyo ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, ma'aunin da aka tabbatar da ingancinsa daga Kudancin Duniya, wanda ke ɗaukar amfani da AI a matsayin wani ɓangare na yadda ɗalibai ke rayuwar jami'a, kayan aiki ne mai amfani da ƙungiyar za ta iya daidaitawa don binciken ɗalibai a Afirka ta Kudu, tare da gargaɗin marubutan cewa yana auna ra'ayi ne, ba koyo ba.

Education Sciences (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Oxford let OpenAI train AI models on Bodleian Library texts, the Guardian reports
entry.summary:
Takardun cikin gida da jaridar The Guardian ta samu sun nuna cewa Jami'ar Oxford ta bar OpenAI ta mayar da tsofaffin rubuce-rubuce na Laburaren Bodleian zuwa na'ura, da suka hada da hotuna 125,000 na kundin digirin digirgir na karni na sha tara da ashirin, da waka-waka 10,000 na titi daga zamanin Tudor, don taimakawa horar da samfuran AI nata. Haɗin gwiwar Oxford da OpenAI, da aka sanar a shekarar 2025, an gabatar da shi a matsayin aikin fadada damar samun tsofaffin takardu masu wuyar samu; ba a bayyana cewa za a yi amfani da hotunan don horar da bayanan OpenAI ba. Takardun taro na cikin gida sun nuna cewa mambobin kwamitin gudanarwa sun bayyana damuwa kan illar da za ta iya shafar daraja da kudin makamashi na AI, yayin da Oxford ta ce abubuwan sun yi kadan, ba karkashin hakkin mallaka ba, kuma za a buga su a yanar gizo cikin watanni masu zuwa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai ɗa'a, da'a da manufofi, wannan lamari gargaɗi ne ga kowace jami'a, a Kudancin Duniya ko a Oxford, da take ba kamfanin AI damar samun takardunta ko bayananta: idan ba a bayyana wa jama'a a sarari yadda za a yi amfani da abubuwan ba, aikin samun dama na gaskiya na iya zama, daga baya, kamar yarjejeniyar ba da bayanai a asirce, kuma shi ne gibin bayyana gaskiya da Wits AHEAD take bukatar hukumomi su rufe kafin su sa hannu.

The Guardian (Ethan Penny and Dan Milmo) · Established press investigation

entry.title: University of Ghana approves an AI policy and a compulsory digital literacy course for every student
entry.summary:
Majalisar Jami'ar Ghana ta amince da manufar AI da za ta shafi dukkan jami'ar, wadda aka tsara bayan bincike na cikin gida da ya gano gibi a horarwa, karancin damar samun kayan aikin AI, da damuwa kan daidaito, gaskiyar ilimi da da'a. A yayin sanar da wannan a bikin kammala karatu da aka yi a Accra, inda dalibai 1,884 suka kammala, mataimakin shugaban jami'ar, Farfesa Nana Aba Appiah Amfo, ta ce jami'ar za ta kuma bukaci kowane dalibi, daga shekarar karatu mai zuwa, ya dauki sabon darasi na wajibi kan ilimin dijital da AI mai amfani, tare da manufar koyarwa da koyo daban.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, yadda jami'ar gwamnati take matsawa daga takardun jagora zuwa darasin wajibi na ilimin AI ga kowane dalibin da ya kammala, wanda aka gina kan nata shaidar wuraren da dalibai da ma'aikata suke fama, shi ne irin martani mai tsari da ya shafi dukkan harabar jami'a da Wits AHEAD take nema a fadin nahiyar, maimakon manufofin da suke kawai a takarda.

University of Ghana (policy document); Ghanaian Times · University policy document

entry.title: OECD finds generative AI use nearly universal in higher education but only one in five institutions has a formal policy
entry.summary:
Rahoton OECD, Policies supporting responsible and systematic GenAI adoption in higher education, wanda aka buga a cikin jerin OECD Education Spotlights, ya gano cewa yin amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki a tsakanin daliban jami'a ya kusan zama na kowa, yana karuwa daga kashi 66 cikin dari na daliban digiri na farko a Birtaniya a shekarar 2024 zuwa kashi 95 cikin dari a 2026, inda kashi 86 cikin dari na dalibai a binciken da aka yi a kasashe 16 suke amfani da shi. Duk da haka, kashi 19 cikin dari ne kawai na hukumomin manyan makarantu a duniya suka mallaki manufar AI mai samar da abun ciki ta hukuma a shekarar 2025, ko da yake kashi 42 cikin dari na daban suna tsara nata, kuma kashi 17 cikin dari ne kawai na ma'aikatan ilimi a duniya aka kirga a matsayin masu amfani da fasaha ko kwararru.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai ɗa'a, da'a da manufofi, gibin da OECD take awon, tsakanin yin amfani na yau da kullum da ya kusan zama na kowa da gudanarwa ta hukuma a jami'a daya cikin biyar, shi ne ainihin gibin da aka kafa Wits AHEAD domin taimakawa rufe shi, da tunatarwa cewa karbar kayan aikin AI da gudanar da su cikin ɗa'a ayyuka biyu ne daban-daban da mafi yawan jami'o'i ba su kammala ko daya daga cikinsu ba.

University World News (Karen MacGregor), reporting an OECD report · Intergovernmental research report, reported by established press

entry.title: African universities urged to collaborate and use AI responsibly, Times Higher Education summit hears
entry.summary:
A taron Times Higher Education World Academic Summit da aka yi a Cape Town, manajan bunƙasa kasuwanci na ƙungiyar don yankin Kudancin Sahara na Afirka, Mosebjadi Petje, ya yi kira ga jami'o'in Afirka da su raba kayan aikin bincike da ƙwarewa domin magance matsalolin da suka haɗa kai kamar sauyin yanayi da rashin aikin yi na matasa, da kuma su karɓi AI "cikin ɗa'a" maimakon su ƙi ta. Ya kuma ƙarfafa cibiyoyi da su yi amfani da bayanansu don yanke shawarwari masu muhimmanci, ba don jerin sunayen jami'o'i kaɗai ba, yana jawabi ga wakilai daga jami'o'i kusan 55 na Kudancin Sahara na Afirka da ke cikin jerin Times Higher Education World University Rankings.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, kiran da ya fito daga cikin sashin jami'o'in Afirka kansa don raba kayan aiki da amfani da AI cikin ɗa'a, maimakon dokokin da ake shigo da su daga waje, yana daidaita kai tsaye da hanyar haɗin kai da Afirka ke jagoranta wajen gudanar da AI a manyan makarantu, wanda Wits AHEAD take bi.

Channel Africa (SABC international service) · Established broadcaster

entry.title: US unemployment rate for university graduates falls to 2.5%, lowest of any education group, official data show
entry.summary:
Hukumar Kididdigar Kwadago ta Amurka ta ce adadin rashin aikin yi ga masu digiri na farko ko mafi girma ya ragu zuwa kashi 2.5 cikin ɗari a watan Satumba 2026, daga kashi 2.7 a watan Agusta, har yanzu shi ne mafi ƙanƙanta a tsakanin dukkan matakan ilimi da hukumar take bibiya. Rahoton, USDL-26-1549, ya kuma nuna cewa rashin aikin yi ga ma'aikata marasa digirin jami'a ya fi girma da wasu kashi-kashi a wannan wata.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 4, AI, ƙwarewar ɗaliban da suka kammala, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, bayanan hukuma na Amurka da suka nuna tazarar rashin aikin yi ta sake ƙaruwa ga masu digiri abu ne mai tunatar da cewa, ko da yake AI tana sauya ɗaukar ma'aikata na farko a duk duniya, digirin jami'a yana ci gaba da samar da riba mai ƙima a kasuwar aikin yi, abin da bincike na Wits AHEAD kan samun aikin yi yake gwaji a Kudancin Duniya.

US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment Situation News Release (September 2026) · National statistics office

entry.title: UCT vice-chancellor says all students will be trained to use AI, not banned from it
entry.summary:
Yana jawabi a taron Times Higher Education World Academic Summit da aka yi a Cape Town, mataimakin shugaban Jami'ar Cape Town, Farfesa Mosa Moshabela, ya ce jami'ar ta koma daga hana amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki zuwa koyar da dukkan ɗalibai yadda za su yi amfani da ita cikin ɗa'a, a matakai daban-daban. UCT ta daina dogaro da kayan aikin gane AI don bincikar aikin ɗalibai, kuma yanzu tana kallon AI, a cewarsa, a matsayin "abokiyar aiki a cikin tsarin koyarwa da koyo". Jami'ar tana kuma yin ƙoƙari don samar da kayan aikin AI ga mutane a wajen harabar jami'ar, domin kayan aikin kasuwanci har yanzu suna da tsada ga al'ummomi da yawa a nahiyar.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, sauyin daga hana amfani da AI zuwa koyar da dukkan ɗalibai shi ne alamar fili mafiya bayyana cewa babbar jami'a a Kudancin Duniya tana kallon sanin AI a matsayin ƙwarewa ta asali ga ɗaliban da suka kammala, ba matsalar tsarin ladabtarwa ba, hanya da aikin Wits AHEAD kan tantancewa da gaskiya yake bi da kyau.

University of Cape Town News (story by Niémah Davids) · University announcement

entry.title: AI governance becomes higher education's top technology priority for the first time, EDUCAUSE survey finds
entry.summary:
EDUCAUSE, ƙungiyar fasahar ilimi mai zurfi ta Amurka da Kanada, ta ce bincikenta na 2027 kan Manyan Matsalolin IT Goma, da aka gudanar tare da shugabannin fasaha 882, ya sanya tambayar inda AI take ƙara ƙima ta gaskiya a matsayi na farko a karon farko, ta zarce tsaron yanar gizo. Ƙirƙirar tsarin AI don sabuwar ƙirƙira mai ɗa'a da kuma gina tsarin kula da bayanai mai ƙarfi su ma sun kasance cikin manyan goman, daga mafi girman adadin masu amsa binciken da aka taɓa samu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, sakamakon ya nuna cewa gudanar da AI ya zama babban tambaya ta fasaha a ilimi mai zurfi a Arewacin Duniya da Kudancin Duniya, canji wanda aikin manufofin Wits AHEAD yake amsawa kai tsaye.

EDUCAUSE 2027 Top 10 IT Issues (via Campus Technology) · Higher education technology association survey

entry.title: University of Pretoria vice-chancellor says graduates need AI fluency and power skills, not just a degree, to find work
entry.summary:
A cikin wata kasida da ya rubuta a Daily Maverick, Mataimakin Shugaban Jami'ar Pretoria, Farfesa Francis Petersen, ya ce rashin aikin yi ga waɗanda suka kammala karatu a Afirka ta Kudu yana ci gaba tare da ƙarancin ƙwarewa daga ma'aikata saboda jami'o'i har yanzu suna shirya ɗalibai don aiki na farko ɗaya kawai maimakon sauye-sauyen sana'a na rayuwa gaba ɗaya. Ya ce ma'aikata yanzu suna sa ran waɗanda suka kammala karatu da za su iya amfani da AI da niyya, tare da sadarwa, haɗin kai da tunani mai zurfi, kuma yana kira da horo a wurin aiki, koyo da haɗin aiki, da tallafin kasuwanci a kowane fanni.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, mataimakin shugaban jami'a na Afirka ta Kudu da ya ambaci saninsa da AI a matsayin babban ƙwarewar samun aikin yi, tare da ƙwarewar da ma'aikata suka riga suka buƙaci, yana ƙarfafa aikin Wits AHEAD da yake haɗa nazari, manhaja da sakamakon waɗanda suka kammala karatu.

Daily Maverick (Professor Francis Petersen, Vice-Chancellor, University of Pretoria) · University vice-chancellor opinion article, established press

entry.title: Bangladeshi university students show moderate knowledge but mixed practice on AI-assisted plagiarism, study finds
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da ya shafi ɗalibai 386 a jami'o'in gwamnati da masu zaman kansu a Bangladesh, wanda aka buga a mujallar AI and Ethics, ya gano matsakaicin sani da ɗabi'un da ba su daidaita ba game da AI-giarism, wato yin amfani da kayan AI mai samar da abun ciki don samar da aiki da ake gabatarwa a matsayin na ɗalibin kansa, ko da yake halayen ɗalibai game da gaskiyar ilimi sun kasance masu kyau a general. Halayen sun bambanta sosai bisa ga irin jami'a, matsayin zama, gogewar bugawa da fannin karatu, kuma ɗalibai da suka sami horo na rubutun ilimi sun ba da rahoton ɗabi'u mafi kyau.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a ilimi mai zurfi, tantancewa da gaskiya, wannan gano cewa kyakkyawan hali ba ya tabbatar da kyakkyawan aiki yana tunatar da cewa saninsa da AI, ba manufofi kaɗai ba, ne ke kare gaskiyar tantancewa, tambaya mai muhimmanci ga abokan Wits AHEAD na Kudancin Duniya.

AI and Ethics (Noakhali Science and Technology University) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Lisbon university combines early-warning alerts with compulsory AI literacy to protect first-year students, study finds
entry.summary:
Wani bincike na cibiya gaba ɗaya na Iscte, Cibiyar Jami'ar Lisbon, da aka buga a mujallar Education Sciences, ya kwatanta shekaru tara na haɗa tsarin gargaɗi da wuri wanda ya dogara da ƙa'idoji don gane ɗaliban shekara ta farko masu haɗari da kuma darasi na ƙwarewar AI mai zurfi wanda dole ne a harabar jami'a ɗaya kuma na zaɓi a wata. Marubutan sun ba da rahoton cewa haɗarin ilimi yana tattare a cikin ƙungiyoyi da za a iya gane su, kuma cewa tushen ƙwarewar AI na gama gari mai yiwuwa ne, amma taimako yana kai wa kaɗan daga cikin waɗanda aka gano, kuma tsarin hasashe da aka horar da shi a kan rukuni ɗaya ba ya aiki da kyau ga na gaba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 2, nazarin hasashe don nasarar ɗalibai, riƙe su da gargaɗi da wuri, gano gaskiya cewa taimako da hasashe duka suna da iyaka ta gaskiya, gargaɗi mai amfani ga Wits AHEAD yayin da take auna kayan aikinta na gargaɗi da wuri da albarkatun da ake buƙata don aiki a kai.

Education Sciences (Iscte - University Institute of Lisbon) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: OECD data show graduate unemployment rising for the first time since its records began
entry.summary:
Rahoton OECD na Education at a Glance 2026, wanda aka ƙaddamar a ranar 29 ga Satumba 2026, ya gano cewa rashin aikin yi tsakanin matasa masu shekaru 25 zuwa 34 da ke da digiri na jami'a ya ƙaru da kashi 0.4 cikin ɗari a ƙasashe membobi tsakanin 2023 da 2025, yayin da rashin aikin yi tsakanin waɗanda ke da ilimin sakandare kawai ya ragu da kashi 0.2 cikin ɗari, abin da ya taƙaita gibin da aka saba gani, kuma shi ne karo na farko da hakan ya faru tun da aka fara tattara waɗannan alƙaluma a shekarar 2000. Koriya ta Kudu ta nuna wannan yanayi a fili: kashi 71.1 cikin ɗari na matasanta masu shekaru 25 zuwa 34 suna da takardar shaidar manyan makarantu, fiye da matsakaicin OECD na kashi 47.5 cikin ɗari, amma yawan aikin yi ga waɗanda suka kammala karatu a ƙasar na kashi 80.1 cikin ɗari ya gaza matsakaicin OECD na kashi 86 cikin ɗari.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, wannan ita ce alama mafi bayyana zuwa yanzu a faɗin ƙasashen OECD cewa amfanin digiri a kasuwar ƙwadago yana raguwa a daidai lokacin da AI ke sauya ayyukan matakin farko, yanayin da ya kamata Wits AHEAD ta bibiya tare da bayanan Afirka ta Kudu kan inda waɗanda suka kammala karatu ke zuwa.

OECD, Education at a Glance 2026 (via UPI) · Intergovernmental body data, reported by an international wire service

entry.title: Côte d'Ivoire launches UNESCO-backed AI training for 3,000 vocational education teachers
entry.summary:
Ƙaramin Ministan Ilimin Fasaha da Koyar da Sana'o'i na Côte d'Ivoire, Jean-Louis Moulot, ya ƙaddamar a ranar 25 ga Satumba 2026 da shirin horar da malaman koyar da sana'o'i, masu sa ido kan koyarwa da jami'an gudanarwa 3,000 a fannin ƙirƙirarriyar basira (AI), tare da tallafin fasaha daga UNESCO. Kashi na farko zai gudana daga 1 ga Oktoba zuwa 30 ga Disamba 2026, inda za a horar da malamai 1,000 a Abidjan kan tushen AI, amfaninsa a ilimi, hanyoyin tantancewa, ɗa'a da tsaron bayanai, kafin a tantance gwajin don faɗaɗa shi a faɗin ƙasar.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 3, AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai, wannan shiri ne da ba kasafai ake samu ba wanda gwamnati ke jagoranta tare da goyon bayan UNESCO, kuma yana horar da masu horar da malamai da kansu ba ɗalibansu kaɗai ba, samfurin da Wits AHEAD za ta iya amfani da shi a aikinta tare da kwalejojin fasaha da koyar da sana'o'i na Afirka ta Kudu.

TrendsnAfrica · Government programme launch with UNESCO technical support, reported by regional press

entry.title: Ghana commits to train 100,000 TVET facilitators in AI under new UNESCO and Microsoft partnership
entry.summary:
Hukumar Ilimin Fasaha da Koyar da Sana'o'i (TVET) ta Ghana ta sanya hannu kan yarjejeniyar fahimtar juna tare da UNESCO, KPMG da Microsoft a ranar 30 ga Satumba 2026 don horar da aƙalla masu koyarwa 100,000 na TVET a fannin ƙirƙirarriyar basira da ƙwarewar dijital ƙarƙashin shirin AI EmpowerED. Babban daraktan Hukumar TVET, Dr Eric Kofi Adzroe, ya ce haɗin gwiwar na nuna sauyi zuwa tsarin da ya dace da masana'antu, wanda fasaha ke tafiyarwa kuma yake mai da hankali kan sakamako, yayin da wakilin UNESCO a ƙasar, Edmond Moukala, ya sanya hannu kan yarjejeniyar a madadin ƙungiyar.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, ba wa masu koyar da fasaha da sana'o'i ƙwarewar AI a wannan mataki zai iya sauya yadda dukkan wani ƙarni na masu sana'a da ƙwararrun fasaha na Afirka ke shiga kasuwar ƙwadagon da AI ke sauyawa, samfurin da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya don ɗaukar darussan da suka dace da ɓangaren TVET na Afirka ta Kudu.

Graphic Online · National press, government partnership announcement

entry.title: US learning platform data shows AI tools trail far behind other classroom technology
entry.summary:
Sabon rahoton Instructure na EdTech Top 40, wanda aka gina kan bayanan da aka ɓoye sunaye na masu amfani miliyan 19.5 a manyan makarantu na dandalin koyo na Canvas tsakanin Satumba 2025 da Afrilu 2026, ya gano cewa Google Gemini, kayan aikin AI na musamman da aka fi amfani da shi, ya kai ga masu amfani 87,788 kacal a cibiyoyi 211, kuma bai shiga cikin kayan aiki 100 da aka fi haɗawa ba. Tsofaffin kayan aiki kamar McGraw Hill, mai masu amfani miliyan 11.3, tantance kwasa-kwasai na Watermark da Zoom sun ci gaba da kasancewa mafi amfani nesa ba kusa ba. Mataimakin shugaban Instructure, Ryan Lufkin, ya ce jami'o'i suna sanya hannu kan yarjejeniyoyin AI na dukkan cibiya ba tare da sun riga sun shigar da kayan aikin cikin aikin kwas na yau da kullum ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, gibin da ke tsakanin lasisin AI na cibiyoyi da ainihin amfani a aji gargaɗi ne da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya: sayen damar amfani da kayan aikin AI ba ɗaya yake da shigar da su cikin koyarwa da tantancewa ba, kuma aikin ƙungiyar kan amfani a aikace yana magana kai tsaye kan wannan gibi.

Inside Higher Ed · Established press report on industry usage data

entry.title: UNESCO programme trains over 100 rural teachers and principals across China and Southeast Asia in AI and STEM
entry.summary:
UNESCO ta bayar da rahoto a ranar 30 ga Satumba 2026 cewa Shirinta na Gina Ƙarfin Malamai da Shugabannin Makarantu na China da Kudu maso Gabashin Asiya, wanda aka gudanar a Beijing daga 17 zuwa 23 ga Agusta 2026 ƙarƙashin taken 'STEM da AI: Ƙarfafa Malaman Karkara don Sauyin Dijital', ya tattaro masu tsara manufofin ilimi, shugabannin makarantu, malamai da ƙwararru sama da 100 daga China da ƙasashen Kudu maso Gabashin Asiya. An shirya shi tare da Cibiyar Bincike da Horarwa ta Ƙasa da Ƙasa kan Ilimin Karkara ta UNESCO, SEAMEO RECSAM, Kujerar UNESCO kan Ƙirƙirarriyar Basira a Ilimi a Beijing Normal University da OECD, kuma shirin ya mai da hankali kan amfani da AI da koyar da STEM don inganta daidaiton dijital a al'ummomin karkara da ba a yi wa hidima sosai ba. Farfesa Shahbaz Khan, daraktan Ofishin UNESCO na Yankin Gabashin Asiya, ya yi kira ga 'AI a ilimi wanda ya sa ɗan'adam a gaba, mai ɗa'a kuma mai haɗa kowa'.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 3, AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai, nacewar shirin cewa fasaha za ta iya tallafa wa malaman karkara amma ba za ta taɓa maye gurbinsu ba ya ba da samfurin da Wits AHEAD za ta iya amfani da shi a aikinta na shirya masu horar da malamai a sassan Kudancin Duniya marasa wadataccen kayan aiki.

UNESCO · Intergovernmental body

entry.title: Ethiopia's Education Ministry says AI will support, not replace, teachers as it expands digital learning
entry.summary:
Ministan Ilimi na Habasha, Berhanu Nega, ya ce a ranar 29 ga Satumba 2026 cewa ana tallafa wa malamai a faɗin ƙasar don amfani da ƙirƙirarriyar basira wajen shirya darussa, samar da abun ciki, tallafa wa ɗalibai da tantancewa, tare da mayar da Tsarin Bayanan Gudanar da Ilimi da na Manyan Makarantu na ma'aikatar zuwa na dijital. Ministan ya jaddada cewa ana kawo AI ne don ƙarfafa ƙwarewar malamai ba don maye gurbinsu ba, a matsayin wani ɓangare na yunƙuri mafi faɗi kan koyo ta intanet, koyo mai gauraye da ƙananan takardun shaida, da kuma ƙarfafa haɗin dijital ga jami'o'i da makarantu. Ya yi kira ga tsarin ilimi da ya wuce haddace karatu ya kuma samar da masu tunani mai zurfi da za su iya 'aiki tare da injuna'.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, da ginshiƙi na 5, nazarin bayanai da bayanai don tsarin ilimi, ma'aikatar ƙasa da ta yi alƙawari a bainar jama'a cewa AI zai zama tallafi ga malamai ba madadinsu ba, tare da gyaran bayanai a matakin tsari, irin alamar manufa ce da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya a faɗin Kudancin Duniya.

allAfrica (Ethiopian News Agency) · National press, government ministry announcement

entry.title: Africa must build its own AI solutions rather than import them, says UN scientific panel member
entry.summary:
Girmaw Abebe Tadesse, wanda ke jagorantar Ɗakin Gwaji na Microsoft na AI for Good a Kenya kuma memba ne na Kwamitin Kimiyya Mai Zaman Kansa na Ƙasa da Ƙasa na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya kan Ƙirƙirarriyar Basira, ya shaida wa UN News a lokacin Babban Makon Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a New York a ranar 25 ga Satumba 2026 cewa ya kamata ƙasashen Afirka su gano matsalolinsu da kansu kafin su rungumi fasahar da aka ƙera a wasu wurare. Ya ce masu ruwa da tsaki, ciki har da manyan makarantu, gwamnatoci, abokan ci gaba da kamfanonin fasaha, ya kamata su haɗa iliminsu don gina mafita da suka dace da yanayin gida maimakon maimaita ƙoƙari, kuma ya ambaci yawan matasan Afirka a matsayin tushen ƙirƙira da tuni ke amfani da fasaha wajen magance ƙalubalen al'umma.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, ambaton jami'o'i a fili da wani mai ba da shawara kan kimiyya na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ya yi a matsayin muhimman abokan hulɗa a ajandar AI da 'yan gida ke jagoranta yana ƙarfafa hujjar Wits AHEAD na mai da hankali kan bincike da mafita mallakar Afirka, ba tsarin da aka shigo da su daga waje ba.

allAfrica (UN News) · UN News Service, intergovernmental body

entry.title: Cape Town hosts first African THE World Academic Summit as Wits and four other South African universities rise in the world rankings
entry.summary:
An buɗe Babban Taron Ilimi na Duniya na Times Higher Education a University of Cape Town a ranar 30 ga Satumba 2026, karo na farko da aka gudanar da taron a nahiyar Afirka, tare da ƙaddamar da Matsayin Jami'o'in Duniya na THE na 2027. Jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu biyar yanzu suna cikin 500 mafi kyau a duniya, ciki har da Wits a matsayi na 301 zuwa 325, yayin da University of Cape Town ta haura zuwa matsayi na 147 tare da wata, mafi kyawun matsayinta cikin shekaru bakwai. Mataimakin shugaban UCT, Mosa Moshabela, ya ce jami'ar ta kashe kayan aikinta na gano AI don mai da hankali kan koya wa ɗalibai yadda za su yi amfani da AI yadda ya kamata, yayin da Ministan Manyan Makarantu, Buti Manamela, ya lura cewa matasa shida cikin goma na Afirka ta Kudu ba su da aikin yi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, matakin UCT na barin gano AI don koyar da amfani da shi yadda ya kamata yana nuna sauyi a manufofin tantancewa da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya a dukkan fannin, kuma hauhawar matsayi tare da alƙaluman Ministan kan rashin aikin yi suna jaddada dalilin da ya sa AI, nazarin bayanai da ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu ke da muhimmanci ga kowace jami'ar Afirka ta Kudu, har da Wits.

Daily Maverick · Established press

entry.title: Alliance for African Partnership meets in Dar es Salaam and puts AI skills at the centre of regional cooperation

category.term: Africa (Tanzania, hosted by the University of Dar es Salaam)

entry.summary:
Alliance for African Partnership, ƙungiyar haɗin gwiwa ta jami'o'i 12 daga ƙasashen Afirka 10 wadda Michigan State University ke jagoranta, ta gudanar da taronta na shekara ta 2026 a Jami'ar Dar es Salaam daga 16 zuwa 22 ga Satumba. Mataimakin Shugaban Jami'a mai kula da Bincike, Nelson Boniface, ya shaida wa wakilai cewa dole ne jami'o'i su sabunta manhajojinsu kuma su horar da malamai don kada AI ya bar waɗanda suka kammala karatu a baya, yana ƙara da cewa ilimin AI yanzu ƙwarewa ce da kowane ɗalibi ke buƙata, ba masana kimiyyar kwamfuta kaɗai ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, kiran ƙungiyar na gyaran manhaja da horar da malamai a ƙasashen Afirka goma ya yi daidai da hujjar Wits AHEAD na shigar da ilimin AI a kowane fanni, ba STEM kaɗai ba, don waɗanda suka kammala karatu a Afirka su ci gaba da samun aikin yi.

allAfrica.com, from the Daily News (Tanzania) · Established African news service

entry.title: Morgan State University wins 10 million dollar federal grant to build a trusted AI research institute
entry.summary:
Morgan State University, jami'ar Baƙar fata ta tarihi a Baltimore, ta karɓi dala miliyan 10 na tallafin gwamnatin tarayyar Amurka don kafa Cibiyar Hanyoyin Sadarwa Masu Zaman Kansu Amintattu, wadda aka fi sani da TITAN, kamar yadda sanatocin Amurka Chris Van Hollen da Angela Alsobrooks suka sanar a ranar 16 ga Satumba 2026. Tallafin na shekaru biyar yana ɗaukar nauyin bincike da horar da ɗaliban digiri na uku a fannin AI, tsaron intanet da tsaro da fasahar kwantum ke ƙarfafawa, kuma an yi niyya ne don taimaka wa Morgan State ta kai matakin koli na jami'o'in bincike na Amurka.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 3, AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai, mayar da hankalin TITAN kan horar da masu binciken digiri na uku a jami'ar Baƙar fata ta tarihi yana nuna yadda tallafin da aka keɓe don binciken AI zai iya faɗaɗa waɗanda ke jagorantar binciken AI, tambayar da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya don adalci a STEM a duniya.

CBS News Baltimore · Established press

entry.title: MIT trains faculty from other universities to teach AI across disciplines
entry.summary:
MIT Stephen A. Schwarzman College of Computing ta gwada taron bita na mako guda da ke horar da malamai daga sauran kwalejoji da jami'o'i don koyar da AI da koyon na'ura a cikin fannoninsu, ta amfani da kayan da aka daidaita daga kwas ɗin MIT na "Modelling with Machine Learning". Taron farko a watan Yuli 2026 ya tattaro malaman jami'a 19 daga cibiyoyi bakwai, ciki har da Allen University, Babson College, Brandeis University da University of Massachusetts at Lowell, tare da malaman MIT fiye da shida da suka gabatar da zama kan harkokin kuɗi, kimiyyar kwamfuta da dorewa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 3, AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai, gwajin yana magance wani cikas da Wits AHEAD ma ke fuskanta: malaman jami'a da ke wajen kimiyyar kwamfuta suna buƙatar horo na aikace kafin su iya koyar da ilimin AI cikin gaskiya a fannoninsu.

MIT News · University announcement

entry.title: UNESCO survey finds most Latin American and Caribbean universities use AI, but few have a strategy
entry.summary:
Cibiyar Ƙasa da Ƙasa ta UNESCO kan Manyan Makarantu a Latin Amurka da Caribbean (IESALC), tare da Cibiyar Nazari Mai Zurfi kan Dorewa ta Jami'ar Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya, ta gudanar da binciken jin ra'ayi a manyan makarantu 200 a ƙasashe 19 kuma ta wallafa sakamakonsa a ranar 8 ga Satumba 2026 a lokacin Makon Koyo na Dijital na UNESCO. Ta gano cewa kashi 87 cikin ɗari na cibiyoyi tuni suna amfani da AI a aƙalla ɓangare ɗaya na aikinsu, galibi a koyarwa da koyo, amma kashi 26 cikin ɗari ne kawai ke da tsarin dabarun AI na hukuma. Yawancin shirye-shiryen AI suna farawa ne daga malaman jami'a, masu bincike ko ɗalibai ɗaiɗai maimakon shugabancin cibiya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, gibin da ke tsakanin amfani da AI kusan a ko'ina da gudanarwa ta hukuma a Latin Amurka da Caribbean yana kama da yanayin da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya a faɗin Kudancin Duniya, inda aikin yau da kullum ke gaba da manufofin cibiyoyi.

UNESCO IESALC and United Nations University · Intergovernmental higher education body report

entry.title: University of Colorado system adopts a living policy for responsible use of AI
entry.summary:
Sabuwar Sanarwar Manufar Gudanarwa ta 6012 ta tsarin University of Colorado, Amfani da Ƙirƙirarriyar Basira cikin Alhaki, ta fara aiki a ranar 24 ga Agusta 2026 kuma an bayyana ta a shafin manufofin jami'ar a ranar 21 ga Satumba. Tana kafa abubuwan da ake tsammani a dukkan tsarin kan gaskiya a ilimi, kare bayanai, bayyana gaskiya da tabbatar da ingancin abun ciki da AI ya samar, kuma an gabatar da ita a fili a matsayin manufar da za ta riƙa sauyawa yayin da ra'ayoyi ke zuwa daga ɗalibai da ma'aikata.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiya, babban tsarin jami'o'in gwamnati da ya zaɓi ɗaukar ƙa'idojinsa na AI a matsayin takarda mai rai maimakon manufa mara sauyi abin kwatantawa ne daga Arewacin Duniya ga zaɓuɓɓukan gudanarwa da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya a Kudancin Duniya.

University of Colorado · University policy announcement

entry.title: University of Pretoria trains future teachers in "prompt literacy" for the AI classroom
entry.summary:
Masu bincike a Sashen Ilimin Yara Ƙanana na University of Pretoria, ƙarƙashin jagorancin Dr Joyce West da Dr Kayla Willemse, suna gudanar da bincike mai matakai da yawa kan ƙwarewar ba da umarni, wato iya ba AI mai samar da abun ciki bayyanannun umarni tare da yin hukunci mai zurfi kan abin da yake samarwa. Aikin yana horar da malamai na gaba don amfani da AI a matsayin kayan aikin haɗin gwiwa a aji maimakon barazana, ta ayyuka kamar gina labaran yara da kayan dijital, tare da sa ido sosai kan son kai, kurakurai da haƙƙin mallaka a cikin abin da AI ke samarwa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 3, AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai, binciken yana magance wani gibi da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya sosai: ko ana koya wa sabbin malamai yadda za su tambayi sakamakon AI, ba yadda za su samar da shi kaɗai ba.

Future SA, reporting University of Pretoria research · South African higher education press, reporting university research

entry.title: East African universities and Arizona State University partner to build "AI-ready" higher education
entry.summary:
Majalisar Jami'o'in Gabashin Afirka, hukumar manyan makarantu ta Ƙungiyar Ƙasashen Gabashin Afirka, ta sanar a ranar 9 ga Satumba 2026 da haɗin gwiwa tare da University Design Institute na Arizona State University don taimaka wa jami'o'in Gabashin Afirka su shirya wa AI. Aikin ya ƙunshi fannoni huɗu: shugabanci da gudanarwa, bunƙasa malamai, tsarin bincike da koyo tsakanin cibiyoyi. Cibiyar Zane tana kawo ƙwarewa daga ƙasashe 26 da cibiyoyi fiye da 140, ciki har da bakwai a Afirka.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 5, nazarin bayanai da bayanai don tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, haɗin gwiwar yana nuna hukumar manyan makarantu ta yanki tana gina ƙarfin AI a jami'o'i da yawa a lokaci guda, samfurin da Wits AHEAD za ta iya kwatanta shi da nata isar a Kudancin Afirka.

Inter-University Council for East Africa · Intergovernmental higher education body announcement

entry.title: Maharashtra sets up a state committee to govern AI and data dashboards across its universities
entry.summary:
Sashen Manyan Makarantu da Ilimin Fasaha na Maharashtra ya fitar da ƙudurin gwamnati da ke kafa Kwamitin Gudanar da AI, Nazarin Bayanai da Allon Bayanai, ƙarƙashin jagorancin Farfesa Rajnish Kamat, mataimakin shugaban Shivaji University, Kolhapur. A tsawon wa'adinsa na shekaru uku, kwamitin mai membobi tara dole ne ya tsara dabarun AI na jiha, ya zaɓi muhimman amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki, koyon na'ura da sarrafa harshen ɗan'adam, ya daidaita bayanai a cikin allunan bayanan da jihar ke da su na ɗalibai, jarrabawa da tallafin karatu, kuma ya gina nazarin yanayi da hasashen haɗari masu aiki da kansu a cikin dandalin da a yanzu kawai yake ba da rahoton alƙaluma, tare da bin ƙa'idojin tsaron intanet da sirri. Yana kai rahoto kowane wata uku ga manyan ma'aikatan gwamnati na sashen.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 5, nazarin bayanai da bayanai don tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, wannan yana ɗaya daga cikin gwamnatocin jihohi na farko a ko'ina da suka ɗora kwamiti na dindindin mai alhaki don mayar da allon rahoto ya zama ainihin tsarin gargaɗi da wuri da tallafin yanke shawara, samfurin da Wits AHEAD za ta iya nuni da shi yayin da take kira ga irin wannan sauyi a Afirka ta Kudu.

Government of Maharashtra, Higher and Technical Education Department · State government resolution, reported by regional press

entry.title: Telkom Foundation, BCX and Alibaba Cloud partner with Wits to give students AI-powered coding tools
entry.summary:
Telkom Foundation, BCX da Alibaba Cloud sun haɗa kai da University of the Witwatersrand don ba wa kusan ɗaliban Kimiyyar Kwamfuta na shekara ta uku 165 damar amfani da dandalin haɓaka manhaja na Qoder na Alibaba mai amfani da AI don ayyukan manhajarsu na ilimi. Shirin Qoder na nufin ba wa ɗalibai ƙwarewa ta aikace a kayan aikin rubuta manhaja da AI ke taimakawa kafin su shiga wurin aiki inda irin waɗannan kayan aiki suka zama ruwan dare, da ƙarfafa alaƙa tsakanin manhajar karatun Wits da aikin masana'antu. Farfesa Richard Klein, shugaban Wits School of Computer Science and Applied Mathematics, ya ce manhajar karatu na buƙatar sauyawa tare da waɗannan ci gaban na duniya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, wannan mataki ne na zahiri da Wits da kanta ta ɗauka don cike gibin da ke tsakanin abin da waɗanda suka kammala karatun kimiyyar kwamfuta ke koya da ayyukan injiniyancin manhaja da AI ke ƙarfafawa da za su shiga, a matakin da Wits AHEAD za ta iya bibiya kuma ta gina a kai.

Wits University · University announcement

entry.title: Systematic review of 124 studies finds AI's value in education depends on governance, not the technology, and flags a Global South research gap

category.term: Global (evidence base: Central Asia, East Africa)

entry.summary:
Wani bita na tsari da masu bincike a jami'o'in Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan da Tanzania suka gudanar ya haɗa bincike 124 da aka wallafa tsakanin Janairu 2020 da Janairu 2026 kan yadda AI ke sauya ilimi. Ya gano sauyi na gaske amma mara daidaito daga kayan aikin AI ɗaiɗai zuwa koyarwa mafi sassauci da ke dogara da bayanai, kuma ya kammala cewa ko wannan sauyin zai taimaka ko zai cutar da masu koyo ya dogara ne kan gudanarwa da yanayin cibiya ba kan fasahar kanta ba, kuma dole ne hukuncin ɗan'adam da matsayin malami su ci gaba da kasancewa a tsakiya maimakon ɗaukar AI a matsayin hukuma mai cin gashin kanta. Marubutan sun kuma gano cewa tushen shaidun kansa ya karkata sosai ga wallafe-wallafen harshen Turanci, yayin da ra'ayoyin Kudancin Duniya, na 'yan asali da na harsuna da yawa har yanzu ba su da yawa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, wannan tabbaci ne da masana suka tantance, daga masu bincike da ke Tsakiyar Asiya da Gabashin Afirka da kansu, na ainihin gibin shaida da ke motsa aikin Wits AHEAD: rubuce-rubucen da ya kamata su jagoranci manufofin AI a ilimi da ƙyar suke ɗauke da muryoyin Kudancin Duniya da ya kamata su jagorance su.

Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence · Peer-reviewed journal article
